RE:
City Liquor License Renewals for2015-2016
Attached find a listing of those applicants applying for renewal of existing City liquor
licenses (i.e.: retail, restaurant, limited retail, resort, bar &grill licenses and micro brewery permits)
and Liquor Licensee Actions that occurred during this past licensing year.Public hearings for the
applications are scheduled during the February 23,2015 City Council meeting.
Due to the large volume of paperwork involved in renewing theliquor licenses, I didn't
photocopy each application for your review.Instead, the attached listing provides the“basics”from
application information in a readable format.If you would like to review an individual application
file, please contact me and I will make it available to you.Carol Intlekofer, City Clerk, and I will
be attending the City Council sessions and committee meeting toprovide staff reports.
If you have any questions concerning applicant information or renewal requirements and
procedures, please do not hesitate to contact me at your convenience at Ext.6346.
